content:
ana: Quick sync — we recorded Meridian's customer interview yesterday. Need to get a short quote approved and legal signoff for the case study landing page.

devin: Got it. They gave a few soundbites that would work for the hero section. I'll paste the preferred one below.

lina: Paste here — I'll draft the 2-line teaser and the longer 3-paragraph asset.

devin: Quote draft: "Redwood cut our inference costs by ~40% and made latencies consistent across regions — our engineers could finally stop babysitting endpoints."

ana: Nice. Can Legal confirm there are no regulatory flags? Also we need permission to use the company logo and a one-sentence headshot attribution. @marta

marta: Filing note: please attach the interview transcript and the proposed quote attribution (full name, title, email we used). I can do a redline but need those details. 24–48h turnaround.

recording-bot: Transcript uploaded: /recordings/meridian-2026-03-22/transcript.v1.txt

lina: Pasting the relevant excerpt from the transcript for context:

```
Interviewer: How did Redwood change your production costs?
Client: We saw a drop in per-token spend and the platform's autoscaling meant fewer support pages. It let us standardize across team accounts.
```

ana: Great — that supports the quote. Devin, can you confirm the attribution: "Rae Li, VP of Product, Meridian Systems"?

devin: Yes that's correct. Rae prefers not to include an email in public assets.

marta: OK re: email. I need a signed permission form for the logo and quote. Sam — can Growth/ops push the legal permission checkbox into the interviewer follow-up email?

sam: Yep, I can update the follow-up workflow in HubSpot. Will add a required checkbox and a link to the permission PDF. Also will add an internal tag "cs:meridian-ready" that triggers the asset handoff to demand gen once legal clears.

ana: Timeline proposals: content draft by EOD Thurs, legal redline by Mon, final approval by Tue; aim to publish next Wed. Is that realistic?

marta: Monday legal review works if I get the transcript+attribution by end of day today. Otherwise it slips.

devin: I can get Rae to sign the permission PDF today — I'll ping her now.

lina: I'll put the draft into the shared drive and link it here when ready.

ana: One more ask — can we route inbound leads who engage with the case study into the pre-sales queue with the tag `meridian-priority`? We want reps to follow up for the webinar invite list.

sam: I'll wire the lead routing: HubSpot form -> workflow adds `meridian-priority` -> Salesforce queue "CS Leads - Meridian". Also create a segment for webinar invites.

devin: On webinars — Rae said they'd be open to a 30-min customer panel in Q2 if the case study lands well. Keep that in mind for the calendar.

ana: Perfect. Action items:
- devin: secure signed permission PDF (today)
- lina: draft case study + paste link (EOD Thurs)
- marta: legal redline (Mon)
- sam: update HubSpot workflow + lead routing (this week)

ana: tagging for visibility @here :thumbsup:

recording-bot: Reminder: original audio retained for 90 days per retention policy.
